_read_me: Every number here is an ASSUMPTION unless a source is given. Sources are in docs/02 (evidence register). Change these, rerun `python3 models/cohort_model.py`, and the tables in docs/11 regenerate. Replace assumptions with pilot data as soon as you have it.
_conversion_note: RevenueCat reports a 2.9% median download-to-paid rate for Health & Fitness app-store apps (2026 report, secondary summary, E-BIZ-01). Aeris is a web app with no app-store discovery or trial UI, so 3% of ACTIVATED users is optimistic, not conservative.
_retention_note: Assumption. Baumel 2019 (E-RET-01) measured exact-day opens, a different metric, and cannot be plugged in here.
_fee_note: Stripe Billing 0.7% of billing volume confirmed on stripe.com/pricing 2026-10-31 (E-BIZ-03). Card fee is Stripe's long-standing US standard; confirm for your country. Sales tax / VAT not modelled.
_ai_note: Planning figure between warm ($0.024) and cold ($0.042) cache for Sonnet 5.5 read + Haiku 5.5 screen, from docs/15 v1 arithmetic with 2026-10-31 prices (E-AI-01). Includes the classifier on every text input.
